panels.description: Grandmother's Keel apartment. The medicine sits beside her cup as she gives Alex a worn notebook. Ada stands nearby but remains secondary; leave upper room space.
The notebook lies open to paper plans with a water-drop mark repeating every third junction. Keep the marks clear.
Alex places the casino chip over the plan; the etched loops align with the junction marks. Leave upper paper space.
Ada studies the bookcase while Alex turns toward her. The ordinary bookcase should visibly conceal a seam; leave upper space for her line.

items.speaker: GRANDMOTHER
items.text: He said you’d know when you were ready.
